অনুপাত হবে-
explanation:
$\frac{E_{\mathrm{k}_1}}{E_{\mathrm{k}_2}}=\frac{\frac{\mathrm{P}_1^2}{2 m_1}}{\frac{\mathrm{P}_2{ }^2}{2 m_2}}$ বা, $1=\frac{\mathrm{P}_1^2}{2 m_1} \times \frac{2 m_2}{\mathrm{P}_2{ }^2}$
বা, $\mathrm{m}_2 \mathrm{P}_1{ }^2=\mathrm{m}_1 \mathrm{P}_2{ }^2$ বা, $4 \mathrm{P}_1{ }^2=1 \mathrm{P}_2{ }^2$
বা, $\mathrm{P}_1{ }^2=\frac{1}{4} \mathrm{P}_2{ }^2 \therefore \mathrm{P}_1: \mathrm{P}_2=1: 2$
